zh: AI 整理收藏时会自动打标签,也可以在上面手动创建。
en: The AI tags items automatically when organizing them; you can also create tags manually above.

en: The AI prefers reusing these tags when organizing new items.

zh: agent.md 是总则,待办/记忆是可分别编辑的技能;编辑会直接改变发给 AI 的指令,重置可恢复默认。
en: agent.md is the general rules; todo/memory are separately editable skills. Edits directly change the instructions sent to the AI; reset restores the defaults.

zh: 会自动打上「人脉」标签,记忆列表默认不显示,筛选里选中「人脉」才会看到。
en: This is tagged "Contact" automatically; hidden from the memory list by default, shown only when you filter for "Contact".

zh: 会自动打上「资产」标签,记忆列表默认不显示,筛选里选中「资产」才会看到,并在顶部汇总总额。
en: This is tagged "Asset" automatically; hidden from the memory list by default, shown only when you filter for "Asset", and summed at the top.

zh: 你在对话里说过的长期要求(如「以后开会都留一小时」)会被 AI 自动记在这里,之后每轮对话都会带上。
en: Standing preferences you've mentioned in chat (like "always leave an hour for meetings") are recorded here automatically and included in every future conversation.

zh: 先去「记忆」tab 收藏一些内容。
en: Save something in the Memory tab first.

zh: 先看看 AI 会给出什么内容,不会保存进历史记录。
en: Preview what the AI would produce; this won't be saved to history.

zh: 关掉通知后,结果只在这里和「总览」里显示。
en: With notifications off, results only show here and on the Overview tab.

zh: 写点想收藏的内容,AI 会整理成记忆条目。
en: Write something to save; the AI will organize it into a memory item.

zh: 分类(可选),如 银行卡、房产、保险
en: Category (optional), e.g. bank card, property, insurance

zh: 到设定时间自动执行,结果推送给你。系统会挑合适的时机在后台完成,如果没赶上,到点会先提醒你打开 app,打开后立刻补跑。
en: Runs automatically at the set time and pushes the result to you. The system picks a good moment to run it in the background; if it misses that window, you'll get a reminder to open the app, and it runs right away when you do.

zh: 原文件仅保存在收藏它的设备上。
en: The original file is only stored on the device where it was saved.

zh: 原文已保留,重试只重新进行 AI 整理;未配置 AI 时请先到「设置」里填写。
en: The original content is kept; retry only re-runs AI organizing. If AI isn't configured, set it up in Settings first.

zh: 只有日期、没有时间的事项,当天几点提醒。
en: For date-only tasks with no set time, what time of day to remind you.

zh: 合并更新按待办/记忆逐条对齐,不删除设备上已有的内容;先清空再导入会删除设备上所有待办、记忆和 AI 对话,不可撤销。
en: Merge matches todos/memories item by item and keeps existing content; Clear then Import deletes all todos, memories, and AI conversations on this device—this cannot be undone.

zh: 名称,如 招商银行储蓄卡
在设定时间提醒今天开始或到期的事项。
en: Reminds you at a set time about tasks starting or due today.

en: Its run history will be deleted too.

zh: 对话记录会一并删除,不可恢复。
en: The conversation will be deleted too, and cannot be recovered.

zh: 导出一份包含待办、记忆(含附件)、AI 对话与设置的 zip 文件,可用于换设备或本地留档;不含 API Key,与 iCloud 同步互不影响。
en: Exports a zip with your todos, memories (with attachments), AI conversations, and settings—useful for switching devices or keeping a local archive. Doesn't include API keys, and is independent of iCloud sync.

zh: 已使用内置 DeepSeek API Key,无需再填。
en: Using the built-in DeepSeek API key—no need to fill one in.

en: Existing contacts (matched by phone/email) are skipped automatically and won't be imported twice.

zh: 开启后,待办会在登录同一 Apple ID 的 iPhone/Mac/Apple Watch 间自动同步;关闭后仅保存在本机。更改后需要退出并重新打开 App 才能生效。
en: When on, todos sync automatically across iPhone/Mac/Apple Watch signed into the same Apple ID; when off, they're kept only on this device. Quit and reopen the app for changes to take effect.

zh: 影响反问、汇总和洞察的说话风格,不影响解析结果;默认为无个性。
en: Affects the tone of follow-up questions, summaries, and insights—not parsing results. Default is no personality.

zh: 思考强度越高,回答通常越准确但等待更久;只有支持推理的服务商/模型才会真正生效,其余会忽略这个设置,不影响正常使用。
en: Higher thinking levels are usually more accurate but slower to respond. This only takes effect with providers/models that support reasoning; others ignore the setting without any impact.

zh: 总结/复盘类任务打开「带上今天的待办」;天气、行情这类要开「允许联网搜索」。

zh: 所有条目里的这个标签会一起改名。

zh: 开启后 lodo 会读取步数、睡眠、心率等数据,在本机汇总成趋势;只有汇总统计会发给 AI,原始记录不会离开这台设备。
en: Once enabled, lodo reads steps, sleep, heart rate and more, and summarizes trends on this device. Only aggregate statistics are sent to the AI provider — raw records never leave this device.

zh: 可能是还没授权,或者这段时间没有记录。可以到系统「设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 健康」里检查 lodo 的权限。
en: Either access hasn't been granted, or there are no records for this period. Check lodo's permissions in Settings → Privacy & Security → Health.
note: HealthKit 不告诉 app 读权限被拒,两种可能共用一句文案

zh: 配置 AI 服务后,这里会给出针对这几天数据的分析和建议。
en: Set up an AI provider and you'll get analysis and suggestions for these days here.

zh: 还没有健康记录。体检报告、用药、饮食这些可以记一笔,AI 分析时会一并参考。
en: No health records yet. Jot down checkups, medication or meals and the AI analysis will take them into account.

zh: 开启后「健康」页会读取步数、睡眠、心率等数据,在本机汇总成趋势。只有汇总统计(日均、最近一天、环比变化)会发给你选择的 AI 服务商,逐条原始记录不会离开这台设备;关闭后这一页不发任何请求。撤销授权请到系统「设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 健康」。
en: When enabled, the Health page reads steps, sleep, heart rate and more, and summarizes trends on this device. Only aggregate statistics (daily averages, the latest day, period-over-period change) are sent to your chosen AI provider — raw records never leave this device. Turn it off and this page makes no requests at all. To revoke access, go to Settings → Privacy & Security → Health.

zh: 返回格式异常:read_trip 缺少 name
en: Invalid response: read_trip is missing name

zh: 返回格式异常:缺少 items
建一次旅行,把航班、住宿、想去的地方都放进去,可以按天看,也可以看花了多少。
en: Create a trip and put your flights, lodging and places into it — view it day by day, or see what it cost.

zh: 去哪儿,如 东京四日
en: Where to? e.g. Four Days in Tokyo

zh: 返程早于出发,改一下才能保存。
en: The return date is before the departure date. Fix it to save.

zh: 这次旅行下面的航班、住宿、地点会一起删掉(它们同时是记忆条目)。
en: Its flights, lodging and places go too — they are memory entries as well.

zh: 右上角「+」手动加一条,或者把订票邮件贴进来让 AI 拆。
en: Add one with “+”, or paste a booking email and let the AI split it up.

zh: 这些行程项的时间不在这次旅行的日期范围里。改一下旅行日期,或者改这一项的时间。
en: These fall outside the trip's date range. Adjust the trip dates, or this item's time.

zh: 给行程项填地点时点「搜索」选一下,才会记下坐标画到地图上。
en: Tap “Search” when filling in a place so its coordinates get saved and pinned.

zh: 按「设置 → 资产显示币种」折算,汇率与资产总览共用同一份。
en: Converted using Settings → Asset display currency; same rates as the asset overview.

zh: 给行程项填上金额,这里就会按币种和类型汇总。
en: Add amounts to your itinerary items and they'll be totalled here by currency and type.

zh: 航空公司/航段,如 国航 北京–东京
en: Airline / leg, e.g. Air China Beijing–Tokyo

zh: 住宿名称,如 新宿王子酒店
en: Lodging name, e.g. Shinjuku Prince Hotel

zh: 地点名称,如 浅草寺
点「搜索」选地点才会记下坐标,地图上才画得出这个点;只手打名字也能存,只是不上地图。
en: Pick a place via “Search” to save coordinates for the map; a typed name saves fine but won't be pinned.

zh: 结束时间早于开始时间,改一下才能保存。
en: The end time is before the start time. Fix it to save.

zh: 填了入住和退房,这家住宿会出现在住的每一晚里(退房当天不算)。
en: With check-in and check-out set, this lodging shows on every night you stay (not the checkout day).

zh: 不填时间也能存,会收进「未排期」。
en: You can save without a time — it goes under “Unscheduled”.

zh: 把订票邮件、酒店确认信或行程单贴进来,AI 会拆成航班/住宿/地点。
en: Paste a booking email, hotel confirmation or itinerary — the AI splits it into flights, lodging and places.

zh: 解析出来的每一条都会先让你过一眼,确认后才写进行程。
en: You review everything it finds before any of it is written to the trip.

zh: 取消勾选的不会写进行程。日期或金额不对的,先存下来再到行程里改。
en: Unchecked items aren't added. If a date or amount is off, save it and fix it in the trip.

zh: 没从这段文字里读出行程项。换一段更完整的订单内容试试,或者直接手动添加。
en: Couldn't find any itinerary items in that text. Try a fuller booking text, or add one manually.

zh: 搜索失败,检查一下网络再试。
en: Search failed. Check your connection and try again.

zh: 以下币种暂时换不到汇率,没有计入合计:%@
en: No exchange rate available for these currencies yet, so they're not in the total: %@

zh: 信息来自你导入的订单和截图,更新于 %@。不会自动刷新,请以航司和机场通知为准。
en: From the bookings and screenshots you imported, updated %@. It doesn't refresh on its own — check with the airline and airport.

zh: 导入登机牌或航司 App 的航班动态截图,可以补上航站楼、登机口、座位等信息;之后再导入新截图会更新这一班。
en: Import a boarding pass or a flight status screenshot from the airline app to fill in terminal, gate, seat and more. Importing a newer screenshot later updates this flight.

zh: 更新行程里已有的这班航班
en: Updates this flight already in the trip

zh: 正在识别截图里的文字…
登机牌、航司 App 的航班动态、订单详情页都可以。截图只在本机识别文字,不会上传图片;行程里已有的航班会用新信息更新。
en: Boarding passes, flight status in an airline app, booking pages — all work. Text is read on this device and images are never uploaded; flights already in the trip get updated.

zh: 都是可选的。在行程里点开这班航班,可以导入登机牌或航班动态截图自动补上。
en: All optional. Open this flight in the trip to fill them in from a boarding pass or flight status screenshot.

zh: 没从图片里认出文字。换一张更清楚、正对着菜单拍的照片试试,或者直接贴文字。
en: Couldn't read any text from the photos. Try a sharper photo taken straight on, or paste the text instead.

zh: 没从这份菜单里读出菜品。换一张更完整的照片或文字再试试。
en: Couldn't find any dishes on this menu. Try a fuller photo or text.

zh: 拍一张菜单或导入截图,AI 会整理出每道菜、翻译外文并补上简介,选好了直接给服务员看。
en: Snap a menu or import a screenshot. The AI lists every dish, translates it and adds a short description — then pick what you want and show it to the server.

zh: 菜单照片和整理出来的菜品会一起删掉。
en: The menu photo and its dishes will be deleted too.

zh: 也可以把菜单文字直接贴进来。
en: You can also paste the menu text here.

zh: 菜品多的菜单要整理一会儿,外文会一并翻译好。
en: Long menus take a moment; foreign text is translated along the way.

note: 新建菜单页的确认按钮

zh: 菜单有好几页的,每页拍一张。照片只在本机识别文字,发给 AI 的只有识别出来的文字。
en: For multi-page menus, take one photo per page. Text is recognized on this device — only the text is sent to the AI, never the photo.

zh: 展开已选菜品,给服务员看
en: Opens your selected dishes to show the server

zh: 在菜单里点一下菜品就能选上。
en: Tap a dish on the menu to select it.

zh: 左滑可以把这道菜从清单里去掉。
en: Swipe left to remove a dish from the list.

zh: 有 %lld 道菜没标价,没算进合计。
en: %lld dishes have no price and aren't in the total.

note: 占位符:日期区间、天数、安排条数
AI 调整行程结果卡片标题
占位符:没动的行程项列表

zh: AI 助手是一条持续的对话,不会分段。清空后从头开始,已经执行过的事项和收藏不受影响。
en: The AI assistant keeps one continuous conversation — it is never split into sessions. Clearing it starts over; tasks it already created and anything you saved are untouched.

zh: 到期后每隔一个稍等间隔重复提醒,直到完成。
en: After it comes due, lodo reminds you again every snooze interval until it is done.

zh: 关掉后只提醒一次:事项仍然显示为逾期,你主动点「稍等」也照样有效。
en: Turn it off and you are reminded once: the task still shows as overdue, and tapping Snooze yourself still works.

zh: 到期后每隔一个稍等间隔重复提醒,直到完成。
en: After it comes due, lodo reminds you again every snooze interval until it is done.

zh: 关掉后只提醒一次:事项仍然显示为逾期,你主动点「稍等」也照样有效。
en: Turn it off and you are reminded once: the task still shows as overdue, and tapping Snooze yourself still works.
